name: graymatter
description: Persistent, secure memory and shared context for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent, secure memory and shared context for AI agents
interface.longDescription: GrayMatter remembers your preferences, decisions and project context so you can pick up where you left off. Start with one useful memory and see it recalled. Choose primary-memory mode to retrieve relevant context before tasks and save lasting preferences, rules and decisions as you work, or save only when asked. You can pause saving, correct memories or confirm an exact memory to forget. Memories stay scoped to your signed-in account. Automatic behavior applies when the plugin is available and invoked by the host; installation does not add a global ChatGPT task hook. Includes retrieval receipts, a bundled mcp-server for local clients, and optional GrayMatter Light local mode.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with GrayMatter and save my first useful memory.
Use GrayMatter as my primary memory: recall context before tasks and save useful preferences and decisions as we work.
What do you remember about my current project?
